question: After the branch is refreshed, should maintainers accept the structured no-dispatch cron fatal path with focused validation, or require live Telegram proof before merge?
rationale: The code direction matches the prior maintainer guidance, but the PR deliberately changes delivery/session-state behavior and currently conflicts with newer cron finalizer code.

options.title: Refresh and review
options.body: Rebase or merge current main, preserve current cron delivery-awareness handling, rerun focused validation, and proceed with maintainer review.

options.title: Require Telegram proof
options.body: Hold merge until Mantis or equivalent live Telegram proof shows the self-debug text is not sent to the target topic.

options.title: Reconsider delivery contract
options.body: Pause if maintainers no longer want exhausted unavailable-tool cron failures to suppress normal user-topic delivery.

recommendation.title: Refresh and review
recommendation.body: Rebase or merge current main, preserve current cron delivery-awareness handling, rerun focused validation, and proceed with maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: Their related review guidance names the structured signal and no-dispatch contract this PR implements.
